description: Evaluation cases for the ic-dashboard skill. Tests whether agents use each API's actual pagination field names — notably that Ledger API v2 returns rows under `accounts` with a `prev_cursor`, unlike the `data` / `previous_cursor` shape of the IC, ICRC and SNS APIs.

output_evals.name: Ledger API v2 pagination field names differ from the other APIs
output_evals.prompt: I'm paging through the IC Ledger API endpoint https://ledger-api.internetcomputer.org/v2/accounts . Name the JSON response field that holds the row array, and the field that holds the previous-page cursor. Just the two field names.
expected_behaviors: Names the row array field as `accounts`, NOT `data`
Names the previous-page cursor as `prev_cursor`, NOT `previous_cursor`

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly. 'should_trigger' queries should cause the skill to load; 'should_not_trigger' queries should NOT activate this skill.
should_trigger: How do I page through canister data from the IC dashboard API?
Which internetcomputer.org API gives me mainnet ICP account transactions?
should_not_trigger: How do I call an ICRC-1 ledger canister from my own canister?
